description.zh: 直播流所属应用名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看AppName。
description.en: The name of the application to which the live stream belongs. You can view the AppName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

description.zh: 您的推流域名或播流域名。
description.en: Your ingest domain or streaming domain.

description.zh: 结束时间。格式为：yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ（UTC时间）。 > StartTime 和 EndTime 指定不合法，或者不指定 StartTime 和 EndTime 时，默认读取过去 1 小时的数据。
description.en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

> If you specify an invalid time range, or if you leave both StartTime and EndTime empty, data from the last hour is queried by default.
The start of the time range to query. Specify the time in the *yyyy-MM-dd*T*HH:mm:ss*Z format. The time must be in UTC.

description.zh: 直播流名称。您可在[流管理](~~197397~~)页面查看StreamName。
description.en: The name of the live stream. You can view the StreamName on the [Stream Management](~~197397~~) page.

title.zh: 查询RTMP协议直播流的详细音视频帧率码率

descriptions.zh:
- 调用本接口查询RTMP协议的直播流在设置时间范围内的一组音视频帧率和音视频码率。
- 本接口为监控数据接口，数据采集处理方式不同于计费，不能用于计算用量进行对账参考。
- 适用于获取90天内的历史数据。
- 接口数据延时在3-5分钟。
- 单次请求的时间跨度最大为1小时。
descriptions.en:
- You can call this operation to query the audio and video frame rates and bitrates of a live stream that uses RTMP within a specified time range.

- This operation is used to query monitoring data. Because the data collection method is different from the one used for billing, do not use the returned data for billing purposes.

- You can query data from the last 90 days.

- The data returned by this operation has a latency of 3 to 5 minutes.

- The maximum time range that you can specify in a single request is 1 hour.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun live describe-live-stream-detail-frame-rate-and-bit-rate-data --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --domain-name example.com --app-name AppName --stream-name exampleStreamName --start-time 2017-12-21T08:00:00Z --end-time 2017-12-22T08:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
